title: SLASH · title page
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. Measure the back.

panels.composition: A field of black vertical rain hatching fills the page. The title is one white diagonal slash cut through it, the five letters read in the gap. At the bottom, small, the alley behind the frame shop: the back door's light on wet brick, a mat cutter's blade glinting on the step, no one.
